Appalachia has been filmed many times, and usually the same way. This time I wanted to see it for myself.

I travelled through some of West Virginia’s so-called poorest communities to learn how coal built this region, how it broke it, and what life is really like for the people who still call it home. I stayed with my friend Matt, whose family have mined coal for generations, to see the industry from the miners’ side, then went deeper into coal country to meet the people living there.

This is the West Virginia leg of my Appalachia series. Kentucky is next.
